## Highlights

- Added a playable browser edition using the original Rust/Lua runtime, WebGL2 rendering and Web Audio.
- Added a launcher with three independent localStorage save slots, desktop-save import and JSON backup export.
- Used original game artwork and icons, with automatic fitting and remembered 50%–150% display-size settings.
- Added GitHub Pages deployment after release publication, building the corresponding release tag.
- Improved desktop GPU device-loss handling, presentation recovery and progress persistence on rendering failures.
- Refined native image decoding and surface formats, account-dialog layout and asynchronous account-profile lookup.
- Expanded input-driven progression, reward, save-restoration and retry regression coverage.

## Browser edition

Play at [GitHub Pages](https://lambdaed1th.github.io/angrybirdsstella-rehost/) after the deployment completes. The first launch downloads approximately 167 MB of original game resources. Modern desktop browsers with WebAssembly and WebGL2 are the primary target.

Progress is stored in the current browser. Import an existing save or select an empty slot before starting, and export backups regularly. Clearing browser data removes local saves.

## Downloads

This prerelease provides macOS ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64 and Linux x86_64/ARM64 packages. Each archive includes the runtime data, executables, README, license and build information. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

Linux packages require the system window/audio libraries and a supported graphics driver. See the packaged README for startup options and service configuration.

## Known limitations

This remains an unfinished rehost. Retired Rovio services and real platform payments are not restored; local services are substitutes, and compatible online services require an independently operated endpoint. The browser edition uses offline providers and does not expose desktop account dialogs or platform-store integrations. Telepods testing uses code injection rather than camera scanning. Full natural completion of every level and exact rendering/physics parity on every platform remain unverified.

Repository-authored code is AGPL-3.0-or-later. Original game resources retain their respective rights and are not relicensed by the project's source-code license.
